cover_note: ZIMM produce a Lustenau martinetti a vite in 14 taglie, attuatori elettromeccanici e rinvii angolari, con lavorazioni CNC nel sito di Ankara. Qui trova come lavoriamo e cosa potremmo fare per ZIMM GmbH.

evidence.claim: ZIMM produce a Lustenau martinetti a vite in 14 taglie, attuatori elettromeccanici e rinvii angolari, con lavorazioni CNC nel sito di Ankara.
evidence.quote: The portfolio includes screw jacks in 14 sizes with lifting capacities from 2.5 to 1,000 kN, electromechanical actuators from 25 to 200 kN as well as ZK bevel gearboxes in 4 sizes || Gearbox manufacturing and production according to drawings take place at the headquarters in Lustenau in accordance with ISO 9001:2015; CNC machining at the Sincan/Ankara site || Automation Cable, wire and tube industry Automated guided vehicles Hydraulic steel construction Ropeway systems Wind energy
